sources.title: Best Multimodal AI Models 2026: Vision, Audio, Video, and Agents
sources.snippet: Multimodal AI models can reason over more than text. The current frontier models can read screenshots, charts, product photos, PDFs, diagrams, audio, and video clips, then use that visual or audio context inside a normal chat, coding, or agent workflow.

sources.title: Sora: Creating video from text | OpenAI
sources.snippet: We're teaching AI to understand and simulate the physical world in motion, with the goal of training models that help people solve problems that require real-world interaction. Introducing Sora, our text-to-video model. Sora can generate videos up to a minute long while maintaining visual quality and adherence to the user's prompt.
